Usage: gaia extract submit [OPTIONS] PDF

 Submit a local PDF for LKM knowledge extraction.

 POST /parse/task.

╭─ Arguments ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ *    pdf      PATH  Local PDF to extract (max 64 MiB, 50 pages). [required]  │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
╭─ Options ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ --index,--server        TEXT   Configured LKM index id. [default: bohrium]   │
│ --wait                         Poll until the task reaches a terminal state. │
│ --poll-interval         FLOAT  Seconds between polls when --wait is set;     │
│                                must be between 1 and 300 (the 5s default     │
│                                matches the service).                         │
│                                [default: 5.0]                                │
│ --timeout               FLOAT  Seconds to wait before giving up when --wait  │
│                                is set; must be greater than 0 and at most    │
│                                86400.                                        │
│                                [default: 1800.0]                             │
│ --out                   PATH   Write JSON to PATH (atomic) instead of        │
│                                stdout.                                       │
│ --no-hint                      Suppress Gaia follow-up suggestions on        │
│                                stderr.                                       │
│ --help                         Show this message and exit.                   │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯

 Examples:
 gaia extract submit paper.pdf
 gaia extract submit paper.pdf --wait
 What you have:
 a local PDF, return the task id now  ->  submit
 a local PDF, block until terminal    ->  submit --wait
 already have a task_id               ->  status / result
 Use this when you hold a PDF that may not be in the LKM corpus yet.
 Resubmitting the same PDF reuses the existing extraction rather than starting
 over; still branch on `status`. `cache_source` says where a reuse came from:
 `lkm` when the paper was already extracted in the corpus, `local` when an
 earlier submission of this same PDF produced it. Resubmitting will not hurry a
 running task along: the same user and PDF still queued or running returns
 business error 290020 with the existing task_id.
 Without --wait, submit returns immediately with the full submit envelope on
 stdout (not just the task id). Save `data.task_id` from it and poll with `gaia
 extract status`, or pass --wait to have this command poll for you.
 Extract costs 1.00 CNY per successful paper, or 0.10 CNY on a cache hit.
